articles.title: Rahul Gandhi meeting with President Murmu: Security heightened at Vijay Chowk
articles.description: Security arrangements have been heightened at Vijay Chowk in New Delhi ahead of Congress leader Rahul Gandhi’s meeting with President Droupadi Murmu. Security personnel have been deployed as preparations continue for the meeting.

articles.title: To counter CJP stir, ‘Lal Hit Janata Party’ stages protest in Delhi
articles.description: Around 200 individuals gathered at Janpath in Delhi to protest against the disrespect shown towards Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The demonstration was organized by the Lal Hit Janata Party, opposing the Cockroach Janata Party's upcoming protest at Jantar Mantar. Attendees emphasized that using abusive language against national figures is unacceptable and called for accountability.

articles.title: Student Union Polls Cancelled At 2 Bhadrak Colleges
articles.description: Bhubaneswar: Student union elections at two colleges in Odisha’s Bhadrak district have been cancelled due to security concerns and alleged indiscipline
